$comment: Repositories whose executable renderers are fully enforced by
renderer already references an IAM credential-entry marker.
Background: before this scope file existed, the gate only inspected a Vite config
when the surrounding module already matched an IAM consumer marker. A renderer that
had never wired credential entry was therefore invisible to the gate -- which is
precisely the defect class IAM_CREDENTIAL_ENTRY_SPEC.md section 6 exists to catch.
The observable symptom was a green gate alongside a runtime failure:
'non-open-api request requires Access-Token before request dispatch'.
Scope widens one repository at a time. A repository is listed here only after its
renderers satisfy the standard, so widening never turns the workspace red for debt
owned by repositories that have not migrated yet. Removing a repository from this
list re-narrows it; there is no separate disable switch.
Entry format: repository directory name (relative to the workspace root, which is
the parent of this specs repository). A repository entry covers every renderer
beneath it. An entry may also name a subdirectory to cover a subtree only.
